searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords to find podcasts, e.g. ["technology", "true crime", "startups"].

podcastIds.title: Podcast IDs
podcastIds.description: Apple Podcasts / iTunes collection IDs or podcast URLs, e.g. [1434243584, "https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/id1434243584"].

feedUrls.title: RSS feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Direct podcast RSS feed URLs, e.g. ["https://lexfridman.com/feed/podcast/"].

includeEpisodes.title: Include episodes
includeEpisodes.description: Also collect episodes for each podcast (parsed from its public RSS feed, with iTunes fallback).

maxEpisodesPerPodcast.title: Max episodes per podcast
maxEpisodesPerPodcast.description: Cap on episodes collected per podcast.

maxPodcastsPerSearch.title: Max podcasts per search
maxPodcastsPerSearch.description: Cap on podcasts returned per search query.

country.title: Storefront country
country.description: Two-letter Apple storefront, e.g. US, GB, DE.

maxItems.title: Max rows total
maxItems.description: Overall cap on rows (podcasts + episodes) pushed to the dataset.
